ticks.note: Tick 1 enters `ABO`; its entry action sets `O = false`.
`B` is true: `HandleB` finishes, the join fires and its effect sets `O = true`.
`O` is a variable, so it keeps the value it was given: it stays true.
`R`: the strong abort re-enters `ABO`, and the entry action sets `O = false` again.
